name: Health Monkey
purpose: Continuously evaluates component and domain health, detects abnormal latency, error rate or availability, and creates findings and recommendations.

activity.text: Observed Air Inventory p95 latency at 640ms (baseline 180ms) over 5 min window.
Evidence: 3 consecutive metric samples above threshold; 214 slow supplier calls.
Decision: raise finding 'Air Inventory latency degradation' and notify Dependency Monkey.
No action executed by this agent; verification deferred to remediation agent.

name: Janitor Monkey
purpose: Detects stale resources, abandoned sessions, expired cache entries and unused temporary resources, and recommends or performs safe cleanup.

activity.text: Found 1,204 expired search-cache entries and 37 abandoned guest sessions older than 24h.
Evidence: cache TTL expired, session last-activity timestamps exceeded retention policy.
Decision: autonomous cleanup approved by guardrail (under 25-instance cap).
Action executed: purged expired cache entries and abandoned sessions in staging.
Verified cache hit rate recovered to 94%; no customer impact detected.

name: Reboot Monkey
purpose: Detects unhealthy processes, workers or service instances, recommends or performs controlled restarts, and verifies health afterward.

activity.text: Booking worker instance booking-svc-worker-07 unresponsive to health checks for 3 cycles.
Evidence: 0 successful heartbeats, thread-pool exhaustion in diagnostics dump.
Decision: recommend controlled restart, human approval required (production + >1 threshold).
Approved by on-call SRE via portal.
Action executed: rolling restart of booking-svc-worker-07.
Verified worker healthy post-restart; latency back to baseline.

name: Dependency Monkey
purpose: Evaluates external providers and internal dependencies, detects supplier degradation, and recommends routing traffic to an alternative provider.

activity.text: Air supplier 'SkyLink GDS' response time trending up (640ms p95, +255% vs baseline).
Evidence: correlated with Health Monkey finding on Air Inventory latency degradation.
Decision: recommend shifting 40% of traffic to secondary supplier 'AeroConnect API'.
Awaiting approval - recommend-only mode, any re-route requires sign-off.

name: Deployment Monkey
purpose: Correlates incidents with recent deployments, detects regression patterns, and recommends rollback or traffic reduction.

activity.text: Payment authorization failure rate rose 6.4% within 12 minutes of deploy payments-svc v4.2.1.
Evidence: exception spike timestamp correlates with deployment marker in change log.
Decision: recommend rollback of payments-svc to v4.2.0 pending SRE confirmation.
Awaiting approval - production rollback always requires sign-off.

name: Booking Recovery Monkey
purpose: Detects partially completed bookings, identifies payment-success-but-booking-failure scenarios, and recommends recovery, retry or manual review.

activity.text: Detected 5 bookings with successful payment capture but failed booking confirmation (cruises domain).
Evidence: payment ledger shows captured funds; booking-svc returned timeout on confirmation call.
Decision: recommend automatic retry for 3 low-risk cases, manual review for 2 high-value cases.
Retry approved for 3 cases by booking-ops queue.
Action executed: automated booking confirmation retry for 3 reservations.
Verified 3/3 retries succeeded; 2 remaining flagged for manual review.
